test_newton_cg: test the _newton_cg function to verify it produces the same result as scipy's fmin_ncg on a quadratic objective
test_newton_cg_verbosity: test the _newton_cg function verbose output at levels 0, 1, and 2 including line search and convergence messages
test_check_optimize: test the _check_optimize_result function to verify correct ConvergenceWarning messages for lbfgs status codes
build_newton_cg_solver: build a Newton-CG optimizer using _newton_cg with grad_hess, func, grad callbacks and a starting point array
review_check_optimize_result: review the _check_optimize_result function to validate optimizer results and emit appropriate convergence warnings
